ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base comprising approximately 90% of the visible surface, punctuated by high-intensity (white) focal points comprising roughly 10%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive distribution of discrete, high-contrast white focal points (circular rings and linear segments) scattered across the dark pigment of both lobes. No large contiguous white regions or solid banding are present.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an estimated aperture of 75 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge, characterized by sharp peaks and shallow valleys with a pixel amplitude of approximately 3-5% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips, with an increasing rate of curvature at the outer 20% of the lobe span.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white ring-scars (0-shaped) distributed globally across the ventral surface, with specific high-density clusters in the mid-region of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear tracks; notably a prominent diagonal streak on the left lobe (viewer perspective) and several intersecting horizontal/vertical streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large clusters of orange-tinted stalked barnacles attached to the distal tips of both the left and right lobes. A significant irregular indentation/missing segment is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe (viewer perspective) near the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'ring-scar' density across the dark pigment creates a high-contrast 'starfield' pattern across the entire fluke surface.
